title: Luteolin inhibits the JAK/STAT pathway to alleviate auditory cell apoptosis of acquired sensorineural hearing loss based on network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and experiments in vitro.
authors: Guo, Fang; Guo, Yingyuan; Zhang, Dejun; Fu, Zeming; Han, Shuang; Wan, Yining; Guan, Guofang
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学、分子对接和MD研究木犀草素与JAK/STAT靶点结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: The study aimed to explore the mechanisms of luteolin in acquired sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL) through network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and experimental verification. METHODS: First, the practices of network pharmacology were used to obtain the intersecting targets of luteolin and acquired SNHL, construct the PPI (Protein-Protein Interaction) network, conduct GO and KEGG enrichments, and establish luteolin-acquired SNHL-target-pathway network, aiming to gain the core targets and pathways. Then, the affinity between the core targets and luteolin was verified by molecular docking. Moreover, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation was applied to simulate the binding between targets and luteolin. Finally, with the HEI-OC1 cell line, some molecular biology techniques were adopted to verify the pharmacological actions of luteolin and the significance of the pathway from KEGG enrichment in luteolin-protecting auditory cell damage related to acquired SNHL. RESULTS: 14 intersecting targets were obtained, and the 10 core targets were further verified through molecular docking and MD simulation to get 5 core targets. The JAK/STAT was selected as the critical pathway through KEGG enrichment. Luteolin could dose-dependently alleviate auditory cell apoptosis by inhibiting the JAK/STAT pathway, confirmed by a series of experiments in vitro. CONCLUSION: This study manifested that luteolin could reduce acquired SNHL-related auditory cell apoptosis through the JAK/STAT pathway, which provided a new idea for acquired SNHL pharmacological treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及实验验证，探讨木犀草素在获得性感觉神经性听力损失（SNHL）中的作用机制。方法：首先，采用网络药理学方法获取木犀草素与获得性SNHL的交集靶点，构建PPI（蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用）网络，进行GO和KEGG富集分析，并建立木犀草素-获得性SNHL-靶点-通路网络，以确定核心靶点和通路。随后，通过分子对接验证核心靶点与木犀草素之间的亲和力。此外，应用分子动力学（MD）模拟靶点与木犀草素的结合情况。最后，利用HEI-OC1细胞系，采用多种分子生物学技术验证木犀草素的药理作用及KEGG富集所得通路在木犀草素保护获得性SNHL相关听觉细胞损伤中的重要性。结果：共获得14个交集靶点，进一步通过分子对接和MD模拟验证10个核心靶点，最终得到5个核心靶点。通过KEGG富集分析，JAK/STAT被选为关键通路。一系列体外实验证实，木犀草素可通过抑制JAK/STAT通路剂量依赖性地减轻听觉细胞凋亡。结论：本研究证明木犀草素可通过JAK/STAT通路减少获得性SNHL相关的听觉细胞凋亡，为获得性SNHL的药物治疗提供了新思路。
